result.notes: Every existing coverage value is supported by D029's Fair Housing FAQ section, so no changes were needed. The owner-occupied exemption is stated only as '2-family dwellings, when the owner lives there.' Its application to source-of-income claims is not stated, so it remains listed as unverifiable. Applying it to a given unit depends on owner-occupancy and dwelling type, so requires_unknown_facts=true. D031 (Tenants Rights notification ordinance, ch. 8.71) and DX10 (news article on short-term rentals and algorithmic pricing) do not bear on ch. 14.04 coverage. No unit thresholds, construction cutoffs or preemption relationships are stated in the documents.
